The new test in cli.test.ts checks each one against helpInformation() after collapsing whitespace.
- A2: met — The second test checks that the flattened `factory hook --help` contains `guard <guard's own description>`, so the listing and the subcommand help can't drift apart.
- A3: met — Only the description string changed and runHookGuard is untouched. No existing test is modified; cli.test.ts is a new file. The test run is the proof that the hook tests still pass.
